obligationsRepaired: REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING. Every one of the 66 required-before-filing rows is now identified by the printed line the widget sits on, quoted verbatim from the pinned ACIC binary, and by which blank on that line it is, counted left to right from the widget rectangles the form declares; where the line is nothing but rules the sentence introducing it is quoted too, and where a page prints the same line twice the row says which of the two. A build gate refuses any required row whose quoted line is not printed on the page it is attributed to, whose name is the synthetic fallback, whose disposition is not one the contract allows, or which names no owner or no moment.
